chunks: Al-Ḥasan ibn Maḥbūb narrated from Saʿd ibn Abī Khalaf, from Abū al-Ḥasan Mūsā عليه السلام, who said:
I asked him about the daughters of a daughter and a grandfather, and he said: “The grandfather has one-sixth, and the remainder belongs to the daughters of the daughter.”

key_terms.السُّدُسُ: one-sixth; the fixed fractional share in inheritance
key_terms.الْبَاقِي: the remainder of the estate after fixed shares are assigned
key_terms.بَنَاتِ الِابْنَةِ: the daughters of a daughter; maternal granddaughters in the inheritance case

ai.seo_question: What is the inheritance share of a grandfather and the daughters of a daughter in Shia fiqh?
ai.summary: This hadith gives a legal ruling on inheritance involving the daughters of a daughter and a grandfather. It states that the grandfather receives one-sixth of the estate, while the remaining share goes to the daughters of the daughter.

en.bab-ul-qaim-publications: Hadith.5628 - Al-Hasan ibn Mahbub narrated from Sa'd ibn Abi Khalaf from Abu Al-Hasan Imam Musa ibn Jafar Al-Kadhim (as) who said:

I asked Imam (as) about the inheritance share of the daughters of a daughter and a grandfather.
Imam (as) replied: "The grandfather receives one-sixth, and the remainder goes to the daughters of the daughter."
